dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you seem to be in pretty high spirits, Dr. Livingstone. Did something good happen?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: It's something that might seem troublesome, but is in fact pretty interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: I'm sure that it would interest an adventurer as wise, strong, and disposed to action as you are.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Do you remember the <color=#00E1FFFF>Meaty Tribe's Arena</color>? Lately, it seems like some sort of no-holds-barred fighting tournament is being held around there.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: As I've mentioned before, I still have further research that I intend to conduct in this area. But the whole gorge is all a-bustle these days due to this tournament, which has disrupted my progress.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Still, the idea of a no-holds-barred tournament is a rather intriguing one, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—Intriguing?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: I'm sure that the desire to be the strongest in Teyvat has crossed everyone's mind at some point, right? It seems hilichurls are no exception.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Dadaupa Gorge is sacred to the hilichurls, and strong fighters are gathering from every corner of the continent to this place.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Now, I wouldn't claim to be that strong...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: What I'm trying to say is: You once conquered the <color=#00E1FFFF>Meaty Tribe's Arena</color>. Why don't you give the tournament a whirl?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The sooner you win that tournament, the sooner I can get back to work. It's a win-win!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll consider it.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: I'll do my best to support you, for my part. Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: Can't hurt to lend you my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a bother. It seems that we must solve this issue to proceed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: These three <color=#00E1FFFF>seals</color> in Dadaupa Gorge were originally created to defend the honor of the departed. But I fear that they have now outlived their purpose...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: That is to say that we won't be able to plumb the secrets of Dadaupa Gorge, give these historical relics the treatment they deserve, or conduct any future adventures here unless we break these <color=#00E1FFFF>seals</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Based on the flow of elemental forces, I, the great Livingstone, have successfully worked out the location of the seal which keeps the barriers intact!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>three seal barriers</color> correspond to <color=#00E1FFFF>three Elemental Monuments</color> located in <color=#00E1FFFF>three nearby hilichurl camps</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>northern</color> hilichurl camp matches the records of the "Meaty Tribe" found in the works of the great scholar Allan. They basically are a tribal race that loves nothing more than thick muscles and thick meat. They, unlike us, do not have the spirit to seek wisdom!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The Elemental Monument is located in the "Meaty Tribe" <color=#00E1FFFF>arena</color>. I snuck into their camp to activate it without realizing that stepping into the arena meant challenging them. Next thing I knew — hilichurls everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: *whimpers*

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: If we can teach them a lesson in fighting, we might have a chance at breaking the seal...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some other mechanism...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The other Elemental Monument is located in the <color=#00E1FFFF>southern</color> camp of the "Sleepy Tribe." They are hilichurls that <color=#00E1FFFF>sleep like logs when night falls</color>. Once again, they lack our hardworking spirit that never sleeps!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The Elemental Monument is located in the <color=#00E1FFFF>pool</color> in the camp. When I sneaked in under cover of darkness, there was a huge hilichurl with a shield...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Head east and climb up the hill</color>, and you will find the camp of the Eclipse tribe. According to the records, they are rigid followers of Shamanic traditions. They do not have our adventurous, mold-breaking spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: The Elemental Monument is at the <color=#00E1FFFF>center of the camp</color>. But the Elemental Monument is surrounded by Eclipse tribe samachurls, and Abyss Mages can also be found alongside them...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: I, Livingstone, the adventurer bearing the wisdom that could match the stars and the courage to embrace all ruins, lacks only the brute force to triumph over them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A shame...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: You feel sorry for me too, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: But wrong! In the dictionary of adventurers, there is no such phrase as "feeling sorry"!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Only the phrase "not enough effort!" We must exert our utmost efforts to not leave any regrets! The stars and the abyss are waiting for us, young adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: A pity that there are things that can never be achieved even for a person who bears the Livingstone name...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Clear out <color=#00E1FFFF>the three hilichurl camps and activate the three seal Elemental Monuments</color>... You can't achieve such things without brute force no matter how adventurous you are!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Oh! I am dying, so very dying to see what <color=#00E1FFFF>treasures</color> lie behind the seal barriers!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: If you are a true adventurer and believe you have the wisdom and courage to match anyone, then take up the challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: But my fellow adventurer, take good care of yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Do not let excitement and adventure pass you by — not when there are still infinite mysteries in our world to behold!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you an adventurer?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: I certainly am, though I would be the first to admit that my appearance is more that of a scholar... Nevertheless, my principal occupation is indeed adventuring.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: I have taken a few notes from my recent studies of the Sword Cemetery. Hope you find them useful.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: We adventurers have to look out for each other. Ad astra abyssosque!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: What should we do... Although we worked out how to <color=#00E1FFFF>break the seal barrier</color>, with so many monsters around...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Hmm? Excuse me, I was lost in thought. I am Livingstone, a career adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: You! Amidst the valley flooded by monsters, I never thought I'd encounter another living being that's not a monster!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: You must be one of my peers, a great pioneering adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: With the mysterious stars above and the brooding abyss below, this is what our adventurous souls are made of!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: An ancient battlefield protected by <color=#00E1FFFF>triple seal barriers</color>, which were set up by the survivors using elemental powers, to let their fallen comrades — their graves marked with swords — rest undisturbed.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: But... what should we do...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was lost in thought. Where were we?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Well, these swords... and the <color=#00E1FFFF>treasures</color> among them were the relics of the warriors who fought and died here. How could anyone let <color=#00E1FFFF>three hilichurl camps</color> come rummaging and disturb their sleep?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: We're not hilichurls, so you can't say that what I'm doing is disturbing their sleep. We are adventurers who use their wits to conquer all mysteries and secrets!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: I understand where you are coming from, but the <color=#00E1FFFF>seal</color>...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: What should we do...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: This Sword Cemetery is quite the conundrum...

choices.text: Tell me about the Sword Cemetery...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: This Sword Cemetery is ancient. Presumably, it was left by soldiers on an expedition against monsters some time back in history...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: To stop the hilichurls desecrating the site, the heroes of the past set up three concentric seals to cover it. They can only be broken by defeating the three hilichurl tribes and activating the mechanism at each camp.

choices.text: Tell me about these hilichurl tribes.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: There are three hilichurl tribes surrounding the Sword Cemetery. To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: That's the tribe to the north.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: As the name suggests, the Meaty tribe likes eating meat. They go crazy for it.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: That's why they are so muscular... and complete meatheads.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The unfortunate thing is that the mechanism is slap bang in the middle of the ring they use for fighting contests...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: If you set foot in the ring, it's seen as a challenge, and a massive brawl ensues.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: They're the ones to the south.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: They spend most of the day dozing, but don't be fooled — they are crafty sons of witches...

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Don't let them catch you off guard. They are no fun at all to deal with!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The Eclipse tribe is based in the valley to the east. Of the three hilichurl tribes, they are the most dangerous. They are also shaman worshipers — you should see the zany stuff they get up to every day!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The shaman there doesn't believe in The Seven, but somehow, he can still command the elements.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: There's also an Abyss Mage who crops up there now and then... Honestly, if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I'd have sworn it was just a myth from some old book.

choices.text: Why are the mechanisms in hilichurl camps?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Now that is a good question... Hilichurls lack the intelligence to craft and operate mechanisms like this, so... Perhaps they are also relics left here by the heroes of old?

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: The mechanisms create the seals covering the Sword Cemetery, while the hilichurls serve as de facto guardians of the mechanisms.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: This solution makes full use of human intelligence while also using hilichurl stupidity to its advantage... Maybe this is the wisdom of the ancients in action.

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: Indeed it is. But to us adventurers, danger is just our bread and butter!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: We adventurers live to conquer the stars and the abyss. Anyone who is put off their quest by a spot of bother is going to have a boring life!

response.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
response.text: You take care of yourself as well.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Hmm? Pardon me, I was lost in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Sword Cemetery...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: What the... You've broken the three seals!?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Then... Does that mean you've defeated all three hilichurl tribes too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure does.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Wow. Such an appetite for action... Such boundless wisdom... Such great strength... I didn't know both of us were adventurers!

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Thank you for succeeding where I did not. But I am going to stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: There are still many mysteries to be solved at this Sword Cemetery.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: As adventurers, it is our duty to unearth ancient secrets. So I shall continue to investigate here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Livingstone
dialogues.text: Be careful!
